subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the
stimulus: corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1x 8 = 8 (a) The king asked him why he was making such a small boat. (b) Napoleon, the king of France, was a great hero. (c) One day he was walking along the sea-shore. (d) He won many battles and conquered many countries of Europe. (e) The boy said, "I shall cross the sea and go to my home." (f) Suddenly he noticed a wonderful thing. 11-1,2 boy was brought before him. (g) (h) An English boy was making a small boat. Part-B Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: b d c f h g a e Napoleon, the king of France, was a great hero. He won many battles and conquered many countries of Europe. One day he was walking along the sea-shore. Suddenly. he noticed a wonderful thing. An English boy was making a small boat. The boy was brought before him. The king asked him why he was making such a small boat. The boy said, "I shall cross the sea and go to my home."
